asA: test-author, builder, reviewer, verifier or stage-keeper reading rcf-lite's guidance in an agent session
iWant: the stage I am in named by its commit prefix with exactly what it does and what it records
soThat: no session follows the 0.36.x shape of verifying inside the cycle
description: Guidance topics, the block and the runbook.
title: Every role reads the 0.37.0 stage contract in guidance, the managed block and the bundle runbook

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] When rcf guidance build-cycle runs from the packed artefact installed cold, then its output carries the five stage headings "DEFINE (commit prefix DEFINE:, role test-author)", "BUILD (BUILD:, builder)", "REVIEW (REVIEW:, reviewer)", "TEST (TEST:, verifier)" and "FINALISE (FINALISE:, stage-keeper)" in that order; inside the TEST section, "the full RCF suite against a locally running app" and "nothing is deployed"; inside the FINALISE section, "before the merge" and "writes complete"; and a section headed "VERIFY (outside the build cycle)" carrying "rcf verify run" with "--record" and "writes verified".

[happy] When rcf guidance build-cycle runs, its section headed "Rounds" states that a failed REVIEW (FINDINGS) or a failed TEST closes the round, that the next round starts at DEFINE, that stage order is monotonic within a round, and that Finalise judges the last round only, each in its own sentence.

[happy] When rcf guidance managed/agent-instructions-block runs, then its build loop names the five stages with their commit prefixes, carries "rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref>" with "writes complete" and "before the merge", and states "verified is written only by a release Verify (rcf verify run --record)"; RULE 13 names "merging before Finalise has written complete" and no longer names "verified on the PR branch".

[happy] When rcf build bundle FBS-001 --base-suite <a green record> --format md runs over a fixture tree, then its closing runbook lists the five stages in order, each with a dispatch name of the form "<Stage> FBS-001: <title>", its commit prefix, and the commands rcf build base-suite, rcf build verdict review, rcf audit test-strength --record, rcf build verdict test and rcf build finalise FBS-001 --ci-run <ref>, and ends with "Verify is outside the round: rcf verify run --release <label> --since <ref> --record before the promote"; --format json carries the same in completionContract.

[must-not] No guidance topic printed by rcf guidance, no part of the managed block and no bundle runbook (md or json) contains "--hand verifier" as a TEST or Test-stage step, "rcf build finalise" followed within one sentence by --report, --mode or --url, "verified" as something Finalise writes, "Hand: mixed", "Separation-Reason", "Hand:" outside a sentence that names the 0.37.x transition, or a rule that a Build waits for a spec to be verified.

[edge] When rcf guidance overview runs, then its Finalise line reads as a pre-merge step that writes complete (it no longer says "CI green, merge, then record"); and rcf guidance build-cycle-playbook names "role" for who does each stage's work and never uses "hand" as a process concept (any remaining "by hand" idiom excepted).

[failure] Given a project initialised by 0.37.0 whose CLAUDE.md managed block was edited to add back the 0.36.1 Test-stage line ("rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier against the preview or version host"), when rcf doctor runs, then it reports the managed block as drifted with its existing drift row and exit code, and a fresh rcf init project reads clean.
